query:
UPDATE email_messages
        SET first_opened_at = COALESCE(first_opened_at, NOW()),
            last_opened_at = NOW(),
            open_count = open_count + 1
        WHERE open_tracking_token = $1 AND is_sent = true
        RETURNING
            id as message_id,
            link_id,
            thread_id as thread_db_id,
            open_count
